scope: Shared cold rootfs import, Debian package preparation, optional systemd, iPad environment UI and per-environment Files edits; unchanged CPU/network/graphics acceptance reused.

ffi_tests.includes: Managed DNS migrates only the exact built-in Debian template and preserves custom configurations.

swift_files_and_catalog.skip_reason: Existing opt-in 256 MiB large-save probe; not enabled for this metadata change.

production_ffi.systemd_after_idle_fix: Both terminals, original PID 1 and D-Bus passed again.
production_ffi.scope_note: Cold imports and unchanged Alpine/Debian/custom checks reused; systemd dual-PTY acceptance repeated after the scheduler change.

mac.after_idle_fix: Original systemd services, journal/notify, persistent unit, graceful stop, mode switch and backup passed again at 1 and 4 CPUs.

kernel_conformance.native_permission_retry: All six permission-denied tests passed with native access; other passed results reused.

idle_cpu_percent.method: Process getrusage CPU time divided by elapsed monotonic time while pumping production FFI every 20 ms; 100% is one host core.

ipad.custom_import_device_ui: Not exercised; archive import, digest rejection and custom-image PTYs passed through the production FFI on Apple Silicon macOS.

fixes: Real per-process RLIMIT_NOFILE for original systemd service setup; inherited/shared according to Linux process/thread rules, enforced at descriptor allocation.
Canonicalize existing iOS container root before appending missing environment directories.
Replace only the exact shipped built-in Debian public resolver template with the existing Trames host resolver; preserve user overrides and custom-image configurations.

Masked owner epoll continuations only join worker contexts when actual events, unmasked signals or timeout are ready; readiness observation preserves one-shot/edge delivery and temporary signal masks.
limitations: One active local environment on iPad.
Bundled Mesa/Xwayland/Vulkan adapters target musl; no new Debian glibc graphics bundle.
Systemd does not keep running while iPadOS suspends the app.
Custom images require ARM64 /bin/sh, setsid and their loaders/libraries; systemd images also require systemd and D-Bus.
